crew.maya.greet.text: You must be the new cadet. I keep the plan honest. Ask me anything, and I will tell you what I actually know.

bark.maya.0.text: Board is clear for now. Enjoy the quiet.

bark.maya.1.text: Earth rises in about an hour. Worth a look.

bark.maya.2.text: If you see Leo, tell him the drill is at six.

talk.maya.plan.text: Keep the air and water safe, log the samples, and leave room for an early night. Plans change; that is what the table is for.

talk.maya.day.text: We keep a 24-hour clock even though the lunar day is 29.5 Earth days. Sleep at ten, wake at six-ish.

talk.maya.storm.text: Storm drill: inside, seal, count everyone, wait for the all-clear. We practise when nothing is wrong.

talk.maya.help.text: Inspect anything, open a report, or take the rover. No order, no timer. Stuck? Every task has a hint.

inc.dust.npc.text: That dust is sharp as glass. Put the steps in order so none of it gets inside.

inc.budget.npc.text: Needs before wants. The filter, the seal, the bearing and the nutrients keep us alive and moving.

inc.schedule.npc.text: Sleep eight, work six to eight, exercise two, eat, and leave room to breathe. It has to add up to 24 exactly.

inc.storm.npc.text: No air to slow the particles and no magnetic field to stop them. Shelter, count everyone, then wait.

crew.omar.greet.text: Careful on the steps, they are slick with dust. I look after the air and the water. Both are loops, not supplies.

bark.omar.0.text: Water tastes fine today. I checked twice.

bark.omar.1.text: Filters do not clean themselves, sadly.

bark.omar.2.text: Mind the wet patch. It is wet because it is dust-free.

talk.omar.water.text: Water is a loop. Breath, sweat and washing come back to me, and I filter and test it before it goes out again.

talk.omar.air.text: Air is a loop too. We pull carbon dioxide out, split water for oxygen, and let the plants help.

talk.omar.fix.text: Check the sensor before the machine. A dirty sensor has fooled better engineers than me.

talk.omar.help.text: Ask what must happen before the next step is safe. That question usually finds the order.

inc.water.npc.text: The recycler runs, but the last test was not clean enough to drink. Put the steps in the order you would really do them.

crew.amina.greet.text: Come and see the trays. Everything green here is part of life support, not decoration.

bark.amina.0.text: The trays are perking up. Come and look.

bark.amina.1.text: Plants do not argue. They just grow or they do not.

bark.amina.2.text: That greenhouse is the best air on the ridge.

talk.amina.plants.text: Lettuce, tomatoes, herbs: water, nutrients, red and blue light. No soil, a fraction of the water.

talk.amina.ice.text: Ice sits in craters that never see the Sun. Heat it to vapour, pipe it in, and the loop does the rest.

talk.amina.science.text: Observation first. Grey with holes is not the same sentence as cooled from lava.

talk.amina.help.text: One variable at a time. Change two things and you learn nothing.

inc.green.npc.text: Three trays, one problem. Before we change anything: which two can honestly be compared? A fair test changes one thing.

inc.sample.npc.text: Describe what you see, then match it. Do not guess the name before the description.

crew.leo.greet.text: That rover outside is older than both of us, and it still works. I keep it that way.

bark.leo.0.text: I heard the rover before I saw it. Bearings again.

bark.leo.1.text: Dust on panels is money on the floor.

bark.leo.2.text: Do not drive past sixteen degrees. I will know.

talk.leo.rover.text: Four wheels, 210 kg, 18 km/h, 36 km of careful driving. Slope under 16 degrees, quarter pack in reserve.

talk.leo.power.text: Panels make what the light gives them. Dust steals a slice and there is no rain to wash it off.

talk.leo.comms.text: Radio goes straight. A ridge makes a shadow, so we relay from high ground instead of shouting louder.

talk.leo.help.text: Send the machines first. A stuck wheel is a repair job, not a rescue.

inc.solar.npc.text: Look at the numbers, cadet. Three arrays agree. One does not. Find it, then keep us inside our power budget.

inc.rover.npc.text: The rover does not care that a route is short. Two rules: stay under 16 degrees, and arrive with a quarter of the battery in hand.

inc.comms.npc.text: Radio goes in straight lines, like light. A ridge does not weaken the signal, it shadows it.

crew.sofia.greet.text: Sit down if you feel light-headed. One-sixth gravity is kind to your knees and hard on your bones.

bark.sofia.0.text: Stand up slowly; the first minute is the strange one.

bark.sofia.1.text: Sleep is not a reward. It is equipment.

talk.sofia.health.text: One-sixth gravity feels lovely and quietly costs bone. Two hours of exercise a day is the treatment.

talk.sofia.sleep.text: Fourteen hours on and five asleep is a warning light, not a badge.

talk.sofia.dust.text: That dust is sharp as glass and does not belong in your lungs. Brush it off outside, every time.

talk.sofia.help.text: If someone goes quiet, ask. A bad mood in a small crew is system information.

inc.fatigue.npc.text: Look at the week, not the face. Who is carrying the warning signs, and what actually fixes it?
